title: Uruguayan Stir-Fry Adventure
description: A fusion of Uruguayan and Asian flavors, perfect for the adventurous eater. This dish combines the bold flavors of Uruguay with the quick cooking method of a stir-fry.
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the spring onions and cook until they start to soften.
Add the bell peppers and cook for another 3-4 minutes.
Add the mulukhiyah and cook until it starts to soften.
Add the soy sauce, water, sugar, and salt. Stir well to combine.
Continue cooking for another 5-7 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
